The reasoning 'abandoned the task specification' is partially true regarding the Wikipedia constraint, but the primary failure is the logical jump in Turn 8, not just the source of the refund value. Additionally, the error turns (4-12) include Turn 8 which was a logic skip, not just the retrieval failure in Turn 12. The fix should address the unanswerable nature of the Wikipedia query rather than scolding the agent for using general knowledge.
